one_sentence_story: Using two paintbrushes, a divider screen, and a prosthetic rubber hand in 1998, Matthew Botvinick and Jonathan Cohen proved your brain builds 'what counts as MY body' on the fly — fusing synchronous sight and touch inside premotor and parietal cortex in under sixty seconds.
so_what_for_you: Remember how adaptable your brain's body map truly is — the exact neural flexibility that lets stroke survivors rehabilitate limbs, amputees embody touch-feedback bionic hands, and learners master physical tools.
